E1_pooled_frame_auc.unit: positive-negative frame pair sampled from the pooled 40-operation test cohort
E1_pooled_frame_auc.interpretation: population-level frame discrimination under the empirical operation mixture

E2_equal_operation_within_auc.weights: equal across operations with both outcome states, separately by criterion, then macro-averaged
E2_equal_operation_within_auc.interpretation: within-operation discrimination conditional on criterion estimability

E3_rank_preserving_sensitivity.unit: change in E1 under operation-constant score-location perturbations with E2 invariant
E3_rank_preserving_sensitivity.weights: same locked cohort; lambda scaled by within-operation residual logit SD
E3_rank_preserving_sensitivity.interpretation: estimand sensitivity / falsification; not deployment performance or causal effect
